## Purpose and lifecycle
This is the end-of-life Vue 2 source repository: an ES5-compatible, progressive UI framework. It produces browser runtime/compiler builds plus companion packages for Single File Component (SFC) compilation and server-side rendering (SSR). Primary public build entry points are web runtime variants under `src/platforms/web/entry-runtime.ts`, `src/platforms/web/entry-runtime-with-compiler.ts`, and `src/platforms/web/entry-compiler.ts`.

## Build and published surfaces
The monorepo uses pnpm workspaces and custom build orchestration. `scripts/config.js` defines build targets and aliases; `scripts/build.js` generates distributable artifacts, including `dist/vue.common.js` and `dist/vue.runtime.common.js`. Published package boundaries include the core Vue package, SFC compiler at `packages/compiler-sfc/src/index.ts`, template compiler package at `packages/template-compiler/index.js`, and SSR package at `packages/server-renderer/src/index.ts`.

## Instance and public API layer
`src/core/index.ts` assembles the framework constructor. Instance initialization, option merging, state, lifecycle, events, injection, and render behavior are layered in `src/core/instance/init.ts`, `src/core/instance/state.ts`, and `src/core/instance/lifecycle.ts`. Global extension points—components, directives, plugins, mixins, subclasses—are installed through `src/core/global-api/index.ts` and its adjacent modules. This boundary turns user component options into initialized component instances.

## Reactivity and update scheduling
Vue 2’s observation system converts data and arrays into dependency-tracked state. `src/core/observer/index.ts` creates observers, `src/core/observer/dep.ts` manages subscriptions, and `src/core/observer/watcher.ts` evaluates render/user/computed watchers. Mutations enqueue batched work through `src/core/observer/scheduler.ts`; the next-tick machinery then coordinates asynchronous DOM updates. The optional Vue 3-compatible APIs and proxy-style reactivity live separately in `src/v3/index.ts` and `src/v3/reactivity/reactive.ts`.

## Rendering, VNodes, and browser patching
Render functions create VNodes and components via `src/core/vdom/create-element.ts` and `src/core/vdom/create-component.ts`. The platform-neutral patch algorithm in `src/core/vdom/patch.ts` reconciles old and new trees. The web adapter supplies real DOM operations and browser modules—attributes, classes, events, DOM properties, styles, transitions—through `src/platforms/web/runtime/patch.ts`, `src/platforms/web/runtime/node-ops.ts`, and `src/platforms/web/runtime/modules/index.ts`. This is the key core-to-browser boundary.

## Template and SFC compilation
At build time or runtime-with-compiler, templates flow through parsing, optimization, and JavaScript render-function generation: `src/compiler/parser/index.ts`, `src/compiler/optimizer.ts`, and `src/compiler/codegen/index.ts`. Web-specific directives and compiler modules extend those generic stages under `src/platforms/web/compiler/index.ts`. SFC compilation independently parses `.vue` blocks and compiles script, template, styles, scoped CSS, and CSS variables in `packages/compiler-sfc/src/parse.ts`, `packages/compiler-sfc/src/compileScript.ts`, and `packages/compiler-sfc/src/compileTemplate.ts`; loaders/bundlers consume this API externally.

## Server rendering
SSR runs the same component/VNode model without browser DOM patching. `packages/server-renderer/src/create-renderer.ts` exposes render-to-string/stream behavior, while `packages/server-renderer/src/render.ts` traverses VNodes into HTML using SSR modules and directives. Bundle rendering isolates application bundles in `packages/server-renderer/src/bundle-renderer/create-bundle-renderer.ts`; template integration and client asset injection are handled by `packages/server-renderer/src/template-renderer/index.ts`. Webpack plugins at `packages/server-renderer/src/webpack-plugin/client.ts` and `packages/server-renderer/src/webpack-plugin/server.ts` generate manifests consumed at this SSR boundary.
